title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft HCM → AbsenceManagement

source_tables.description: Absence event header. Leave request with type, dates, status, reason.
Absence daily detail. Per-day breakdown of an absence event (partial days, hours).
Leave accrual balances. Vacation, sick, personal, FMLA, etc. by plan and balance ID.
Absence take (type) definitions. Vacation, sick, bereavement, jury duty, FMLA, military, etc.
Absence entitlement. Accrual rate rules by plan.
FMLA leave approval. Certification, qualifying reason, protected leave tracking.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map PS absence take codes to categories: 'VAC'→'vacation', 'SCK'→'sick', 'PER'→'personal', 'BER'→'bereavement', 'JUR'→'jury_duty', 'FML'→'fmla', 'MIL'→'military', 'SAB'→'sabbatical', 'MAT'→'parental', 'UPD'→'unpaid'. Codes institution-defined in ABSENCE_TAKE_TBL.
FMLA qualifying reason (own health, family member, military caregiver, etc.).
Balance in the corresponding leave plan before this absence.

notes: PeopleSoft Absence Management handles leave requests, accruals, and FMLA compliance. Higher ed institutions often have complex leave policies: faculty sabbaticals, classified staff accruals (union-negotiated), 12-month vs 9-month appointment differences, and FMLA eligibility tracking. Leave accrual balances (PS_LEAVE_ACCRUAL) are the most frequently queried HR dataset by employees and managers.
